evidence: Executed analytic 2D geometry and synthetic inverse-model benchmarks; no physical porous material validated

geometry.grid_rule: Equal-area cell centers, strict clearance > probe
geometry.exact_channel_area: circle pi*(R-rp)^2; regular hexagon 2*sqrt(3)*(a-rp)^2; zero once rp >= inradius
geometry.hexagon_convention: apothem/inradius 9.8 A, circumradius 2*a/sqrt(3); six half-plane normals
geometry.periodic_geometry: One artificial solid disk in a periodic square; excluded distance expanded by probe radius
geometry.clearance_definition: Area-weighted distance of free 2D points to nearest wall; not a histogram of pore diameters

adsorption.STP_convention: 273.15 K and 1 atm, rounded ideal-gas molar volume 22414 cm3/mol
adsorption.regression: Unweighted OLS on p/[V*(1-p)] versus p, intercept and slope retained
adsorption.validity_scope: Positive parameters, V*(1-p) monotonicity and monolayer pressure placement are diagnostics only; no complete standard-compliance claim
adsorption.noise: 64 seeds (pilot 8), 1% lognormal multiplicative error, positive mean-one factor; no inferred measurement noise

limitations: 2D analytic geometry is not a chemical hcb/sql framework; no connectivity/chemistry assignment is made.
Area of allowed probe centers differs from probe-occupiable area, surface area and 3D volume.
Clearance histograms are not experimental or atomistic pore-size distributions.
BET areas derive from prescribed synthetic mass-normalized uptake, not from atomistic mass or geometry.
Good R2 or positive BET C does not validate a fitting window or a physical material.
Noise quantiles are conditional synthetic-repeat variability; no adsorption/desorption hysteresis or experiment is supplied.

sources.role: Definitions distinguish probe-accessible centers, occupied volume, surface, and PSD; software not executed
BET linearization, limitations and conventional N2 cross-section
BET area is isotherm-derived with conventional molecular cross-section; search-index evidence, main host returned 403

license_note: No external structure, dataset or model downloaded; original source retained elsewhere. Analytic benchmark data generated locally.
